title: Father K takes Tyler under his wing in Rome

tellings.quote: and so when we went to the Vatican this priest comes up to him and then they engage and then the priest somehow immediately decides that he's gonna take on Tyler

plain: The religious studies scholar Diana Pasulka says that when she visited the Vatican with a man she calls Tyler, around 2017, a priest she calls Father K walked up to him and "somehow immediately" decided to take Tyler under his wing. Pasulka tells Michels this as someone who was there, and it suggests that people in the Church took a quick, close interest in Tyler.
